stanzas.title: Ka Duitara Ksiar (Opening Overture)
stanzas.khasi:
Tem noh ko duitara ba phyrnai ksiar,
Sawa ha ki riat bad ki lum ba iar;
Pynim pat ia ka sur jong ki tymmen,
Ban sngew ki khun samla ha ka kmen!
stanzas.english:
Pluck forth, O golden shimmering Duitara,
Echo across the gorges and wide mountain ranges;
Revive once more the melody of our ancestors,
That the young generations may hear in righteous joy!

stanzas.title: U Lum Shillong (Sacred Shillong Peak)
stanzas.khasi:
Halor u Lum Shillong ba shong u Blei,
Ka erpyngngad ka beh kylleng pyrthei;
Ki kshaid ki kynih, ki syntiew ki phuh,
Ka nam ka Ri Khasi kan neh ha tnum!
stanzas.english:
Atop sacred Shillong Peak where the guardian deity resides,
The refreshing breeze blows across the earth;
The waterfalls chime, the wild mountain orchids blossom,
The renown of the Khasi land shall forever endure!

stanzas.title: U Tirot Sing (The Patriot Hero)
stanzas.khasi:
Ko Syiem ba shlur jong ka Nongkhlaw ba khraw,
Me la kyntait ban shong kum u mraw;
Me la ialeh pyrshah ia ki shipai Bilat,
Ban pynneh ia ka Hok bad ka Laitluid ha la ka khmat!
stanzas.english:
O courageous Syiem of mighty Nongkhlaw,
Thou didst refuse to live in chains as a subjugated slave;
Thou didst wage war against the British soldiers,
To preserve Truth, Righteousness, and Liberty before all eyes!
